title: Bernoulli subset influence
statement: For a parameter $p\in\mathbb R$, a function $f$ from subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$, and an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define the Bernoulli subset influence at $i$ to be $p(1-p)$ times the Bernoulli subset expectation at parameter $p$ of the squared marginal difference $\bigl(f(S\cup\{i\})-f(S\setminus\{i\})\bigr)^2$.
